ui-consistency.description: Audits UI for design inconsistencies — spacing, color usage, Tailwind class patterns, component structure, and reusability.

code-quality.description: Detects bad coding practices — misused React hooks, improper async/await, unhandled errors, leaky state, and TypeScript anti-patterns.

api-reviewer.description: Reviews backend API code — Express route structure, MongoDB query safety, response schema consistency, auth middleware, and error propagation.

ai-seo.description: Optimizes content for AI search engines — Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini. Helps get content cited as a source in AI-generated answers.
